# Monetisation by Country

This report compares the total revenue and the number of paying users of each country.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

country <- read.csv("RevenueperCountry.csv")

ggplot(country, aes(x = Country, y = TotalRevenue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Total Revenue by Country", x = "Country", y = "Total Revenue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggplot(country, aes(x = Country, y = PayingUsers)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Paying Users by Country", x = "Country", y = "Paying Users") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
